trap.label: Present Perfect
trap.why: O aluno mistura passado e particípio dos irregulares; em português o particípio é regular ('ido').

mcq.q: This is the cake ___ I made.
If you hurry, you ___ catch it.

rewrite.prompt: Una com unless: “If you don't hurry, you'll miss it.”
rewrite.answer: Unless you hurry, you'll miss it.

rewrite.prompt: Junte com that: “I lost the book. You gave it.”
rewrite.answer: I lost the book that you gave.
